patch_description: Test relocating only one particle when the larger-radius regime produces a strict fitness gain. The current policy executes count two in 214 of 1,639 larger-radius responses, grouping gains with losses covered by historical progress. Separating gains could preserve useful ordinary PSO motion while retaining one relocation for exploration. Keep the existing rule for losses: case_009 still has interval-end error 3.38938, arguing against indiscriminately reducing allocation. Fitness gains are imperfect evidence of spatial stability; this is an untested hypothesis, not an established improvement.
